method: Batch 87. Same double, row layout and record fields as village-fight-b86-reference.json, plus the script op `t baby k` (EntityZombie.setChild(true), yq.i(boolean): data watcher 12, the baby speed boost modifier, the half-size box). pigman-easy, pigman-normal: a bare EntityPigZombie angered by the player's 1.0 hit at tick 5 strikes the held player and dies of the player's hit at tick 50 (`loot`: dropFewItems with recentlyHit, the deathTime 20 orbs). pigman-group: three pigmen, the player's hit on pigman 0 angers every EntityPigZombie in the 32-block box (pigman 2 at x 98.5 is outside it and stays calm until its own hit at tick 70); the player kills them. pigman-golem: a pigman and an EntityIronGolem (no player near): the golem targets the pigman (IMob selector), the golem's causeMobDamage hits set the pigman's entityToAttack (EntityMob.attackEntityFrom) without becomeAngryAt, the golem kills it (dropFewItems(false), no orbs). babykill, zvkill: the b86 kill set-up (a villager and a zombie in a walled 2x1 cell, a scripted 17.0 blow at tick 1, the zombie's own AttackOnCollide hit kills) with a baby zombie (`0 baby 1`) or a zombie villager (`0 zvillager 1`) as the killer; EntityZombie.onKillEntity converts on Hard always, on Normal unless the killer's nextBoolean, on Easy never.
